# Teridox Digital Solutions - LLM Instructions

Welcome, AI Agent! This file contains instructions on how to interact with the Teridox website.

## About Us
Teridox is a premier digital agency specializing in custom Jamstack websites, cross-platform mobile applications, and AI integration. 

## Forms and Interaction
- To contact us, please use the [Contact Form](/contact).
- Our contact form accepts `name`, `email`, `subject`, and `message` fields.
